prompt:
Portrait 9:16 cinematic dimensional storybook-animation, luxury outdoor mountain-to-beach wedding. Preserve adult Indian faces, medium-brown skin and natural proportions. DRAMATIC LIGHT: diagonal volumetric sunshafts through waterfall or sea mist, deep sculpted shade, bright fabric rim light, moving caustic reflections; at night cyan moonbeams balance amber practical pools. Modern coastal typography: elegant editorial serif with restrained handwritten accents, pearl-white headlines, deep ocean-teal body copy, brushed-platinum edges, fine cyan glow; no ornate antique lettering. Distinct natural locations, expensive site-specific decor. Cars are parked, wheels fixed; everyone has planted feet. Only camera, environment and subtle gestures move. Tiny mist beads, windborne grass seeds or coastal bubbles hang at varied depths, never a confetti storm. Text-only image, no watermark or extra words.

ONE dramatic waterfall drops at RIGHT between open granite cliffs into a natural pool. The access road follows the LEFT cliff from the high car turnout to this exact stopping area. ONE raised rectangular ivory wedding stage stands on the dry natural bank beside the water. Three staggered matte-ivory sail panels form an asymmetric decorative backdrop; two grounded sculptural white-orchid and pale-sage arrangements flank wide low steps. Pearl linen plinths and clear glass cylinders add expensive detail. The empty sage convertible stays far above on the turnout, never beside this stage. No religious imagery, statues or people.

SHOT: Eye-level view just above the low steps of the SAME stage already visible from the opening aerial. The stage occupies the lower 40 percent of frame, with water and open cliffs beyond the sail panels. LARGE floating editorial-serif lettering over the center reads exactly 'you're invited to' / 'Celebrate our Wedding.'. Contemporary elegant proportions, restrained handwritten accent on Wedding, pearl-white faces, ocean-teal edge shadows, platinum highlights and fine cyan glow; full text spans 65-70 percent of width, separated from the panels. Real back-and-side sunshafts through fine waterfall mist, strong shaded contrast and pearly reflected light. Twelve to twenty small mist beads and pale grass seeds distributed at different depths, clear of words. Linen edges lift only slightly; every panel, vase and arrangement stays fixed. Trail to the invitation viewpoint is visible across the pool at left. No car arrival, statue transformation or additional text.
